section.title: Motivation
section.p: Select a subset of objects based on some algorithm.

strow.stentry: An arbitrary set of objects as input.
The maximum number of objects to select. If the number of input objects is less than this, then all input objects are selected in the order in which they came (i.e. the -sample algorithm is ignored).
The sampling algorithm to use: FIRST, LAST, RANDOM, LARGEST_RETAINED, LARGEST_SHALLOW, SMALLEST_RETAINED, SMALLEST_SHALLOW.
